question: What does 'S' stand for, in the grouping of BRICS nations?
solution:
The correct answer __**South Africa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• BRICS is an abbreviation that alludes to the non-industrial nations of** Brazil, Russia, India, China, and the Republic of South Africa.**
 
• It can work as a base and moreover as a passage for the venture from the BRICS nations to the immense market of a billion Africans. 
 
• **Goldman Sachs** financial analyst **Jim O'Neill **began the term BRIC (without South Africa)** in 2001,** asserting that by **2050 **the four BRIC economies would come to rule the overall economy.
 
• The Republic of South Africa was added to the rundown **in 2010.**
 
• South Africa is now the voice of the mainland at different worldwide gatherings.

• ​The higher Committee for **Sudan relations** with BRICS Countries held a day-to-day gathering at the Republican Palace, headed by the representative director of the Committee, BRICS is the abbreviation for a relationship of 5 significant arising public economies.
